comment_regular: Oblivion equipped-WEAP 3D path on perspective-specific ActorSkinInfo. Accepts form type 0x21; WEAP type byte 5 (Bow) uniquely selects equipment/add-on slot 0x0E, others use slot 9. Loads/clones through Prn, stores WeaponForm/WeaponModel/WeaponObject at +0xDC/+0xE0/+0xE4, then reconciles drawn/sheathed state. External Crossbow contrast: native equipped-model identity is this ActorSkinInfo WeaponForm/WeaponObject pair; a whole ActorAnimData-root search for the first object named Weapon is not identity- or generation-safe. Current discovery is action-triggered and one-shot, with no retry for deferred 3D load, perspective creation/switch, graph rebuild, or successful PostLoadGame.
